title: Foods to Limit or Cook Thoroughly During Pregnancy
excerpt: Food-safety guidance inspired by CDC/NHS/FDA themes: deli meats, unpasteurized dairy, high-mercury fish, and undercooked foods.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, choosing safe and healthy foods is crucial to protect the health of both mother and baby. In this article, we will provide information on foods that pregnant women should limit or cook thoroughly to avoid health risks.

## Foods to Limit
According to the CDC, NHS, and FDA, there are certain foods that pregnant women should limit or avoid eating, including:
* Deli meats and hot dogs: These foods can contain Listeria bacteria, which can harm the fetus.
* Unpasteurized dairy products: Unpasteurized dairy products can contain bacteria like E. coli, Salmonella, and Listeria.
* High-mercury fish: High-mercury fish like shark, swordfish, and king mackerel can harm fetal development.
* Undercooked or raw foods: Undercooked or raw foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw eggs can contain bacteria like Salmonella and E. coli.

## Foods to Cook Thoroughly
To ensure safety, pregnant women should cook the following foods thoroughly:
* Meat and poultry: Cook meat and poultry to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to avoid Salmonella and E. coli.
* Eggs: Cook eggs to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to avoid Salmonella.
* Seafood: Cook seafood to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) to avoid Vibrio vulnificus.

## Practical Tips
Here are some practical tips to help pregnant women choose safe foods:
* Read food labels: When buying food, read the labels to ensure that they have been pasteurized or cooked thoroughly.
* Cook food thoroughly: Cook food to the recommended internal temperature to avoid bacteria.
* Avoid raw or undercooked foods: Avoid eating raw or undercooked foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw eggs.

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women have any questions or concerns about food safety, they should seek help from their doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide specific information and advice to help pregnant women choose safe and healthy foods.

## Conclusion
Choosing safe and healthy foods is crucial to protect the health of both mother and baby. By limiting or avoiding certain foods and cooking others thoroughly, pregnant women can reduce the risk of health problems and ensure a healthy pregnancy.
